responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_builtin_macros/src/format_foreign/printf/tests.rs: Defines regression tests for the printf-style foreign format parser and translator, validating how this module recognizes escapes and substitutions, records parsed substitution structure and spans, iterates substitutions within larger strings, and converts supported printf specifiers into Rust format syntax while rejecting unsupported cases. compiler/rustc_builtin_macros/src/format_foreign/shell/tests.rs: Defines regression tests for the shell-style foreign format parser and translator, validating detection of dollar-sign escapes, parsing of ordinal and named substitutions with positions, iteration over substitutions in larger strings, and translation of supported shell placeholders into Rust format placeholders.
